text:
anna: Quick flag — onboarding "sable-v1" on staging. Small but consistent: CJK punctuation gets a preceding ASCII space. BLEU down ~1.5. Anyone seen similar?

ben: Example?

anna: src: 今天是星期一。
baseline: 今天是星期一。
sable: 今天是星期一 。  <-- extra space before U+3002

rui: That's likely tokenizer/detok mismatch. Did the model bring its own tokenizer bundle?

anna: Yes, bundle v4.1 shipped in tarball. Our canonical tokenizer is v3.9. Quick encode shows inserted ' ' token between last char and ideograph.

olga: Repro on float32?

anna: Yes — float32 and q5 both show it, so not quant-specific.

ben: Short-term: add a token-parity gate in onboarding that runs a small CJK corpus and rejects bundles that insert whitespace tokens next to CJK punctuation > 0.5% of the time.

rui: Agreed. Also add a detok-aware BLEU metric that normalizes ideographic spaces before scoring to avoid noise. But this is visible, so parity gate needed.

olga: I'll diff the merges.json in the bundle vs canonical — likely an accidental merge rule that creates a standalone space.

ci-bot: build/onboard-sable-4512340000 started — unit tests: token_parity_test failing :x:

anna: Opening ticket with samples + logs. Will hold rollout until token parity fix or serving override is implemented.

ben: Thanks — keep this thread as triage record. Will follow up with PR for parity gate.
